headline: Lightning recall Sam O’Reilly from AHL, place Brayden Point on IR
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Lightning placed Brayden Point on injured reserve and recalled Sam O'Reilly from the AHL. Point had 16 points in 17 games, and Tampa took about 60% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him out there. He also fired at 1.25 expected goals per 60 on his own shots and scored less than that, so he was due for more, not less. ESPN's estimated return is Dec. 2. Brandon Hagel is the likeliest to soak up his minutes, and Anthony Cirelli could move to the top power play. With the Kucherov trade saga still unresolved, this is a harder month for Tampa than the 11-4-2 record suggests.
